propositions: ADR-0083 prescribes isinstance-only capability detection, which is safe on Python 3.11 but unsafe on Python 3.12+ due to CPython gh-102433's switch to inspect.getattr_static in @runtime_checkable Protocol isinstance checks

A proxy or wrapper transport with __getattr__ returns False from isinstance(proxy, @runtime_checkable Protocol) on Python 3.12+, causing capability checks to silently skip writes despite the transport supporting the capability

The codebase's single executable isinstance-against-Protocol site (dispatch_apply_phases.py:188) is already hardened with an or hasattr fallback; a tree-wide sweep confirms no other affected sites exist

The ADR text must be amended to document that isinstance is necessary but not sufficient on Python 3.12+, and prescribe the isinstance-primary + member-hasattr-fallback pattern used in _capability_present
All other capability checks in the codebase use hasattr directly and are proxy-safe by construction
